source.mainFunction:
밀크씨슬추출물 : 간 건강에 도움을 줄 수 있음.
비타민B1 : 탄수화물과 에너지 대사에 필요.
비타민B2 :  체내 에너지 생성에 필요.
비타민B12 : 정상적인 엽산 대사에 필요. 
비타민E :  항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요.
셀렌 : 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요. 
비오틴 : 지방, 탄수화물, 단백질 대사와 에너지 생성에 필요.
엽산 : 세포와 혈액생성에 필요, 태아 신경관의 정상 발달에 필요, 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
아연 : 정상적인 면역기능에 필요, 정상적인 세포분열에 필요. 
구리 : 철의 운반과 이용에 필요, 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요. 
망간 : 뼈 형성에 필요, 에너지 이용에 필요, 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요.
source.baseStandard:

2) 실리마린 : 표시량(130mg/800mg)의 80~120%

4) 비타민B2 : 표시량(4.2mg/800mg)의 80~180%

8) 비오틴 : 표시량(90ug/800mg)의 80~180%

source.caution:
섭취 시 목에 걸리거나 불편할 수 있으므로 반드시 물과 함께 섭취하십시오. 
섭취 시 위장장애, 소화불량의 증상이 있을 경우 섭취를 중단하십시오. 
개인의 신체 상태에 따라 이상 증상이 생길 경우 섭취를 중단하십시오. 
섭취 전 제품에 이상이 있는 경우 섭취를 금하십시오.
특정 원료 성분에 알레르기 체질은 원료 성분을 확인 후 섭취하십시오.   
알레르기 반응이 나타나는 경우에는 섭취 중단하십시오.
설사, 위통, 복부팽만 등의 위장관계 장애가 나타나는 경우에는 섭취에 주의하십시오.
이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담하십시오.

가네파워Copper · Manganese · Milk thistle · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc · Folate

Made by 코스맥스바이오(주) · Once a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 0.8mg of Copper, 3mg of Manganese, 130mg of Milk thistle, 90μg of Biotin, 3.6mg of Vitamin B1, 40μg of Vitamin B12, 4.2mg of Vitamin B2, 11mg of Vitamin E, 17.05μg of Selenium, 3.995mg of Zinc, 400μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 0.8mg Copper, 3mg Manganese, 130mg Milk thistle, 90μg Biotin, 3.6mg Vitamin B1, 40μg Vitamin B12, 4.2mg Vitamin B2, 11mg Vitamin E, 17.05μg Selenium, 3.995mg Zinc, 400μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Copper
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the transport and utilisation of iron
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Milk thistle
    • May help with liver health
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Copper labelled (0.8mg / 800mg), 80~150%
Manganese labelled (3mg / 800mg), 80~150%
Milk thistle labelled (130mg / 800mg), 80~120%
Biotin labelled (90μg / 800mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (3.6mg / 800mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (40μg / 800mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (4.2mg / 800mg), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (11mg / 800mg), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (17.05μg / 800mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (3.995mg / 800mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (400μg / 800mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 노란 갈색의 내용물을 함유한 어두운 갈색의 장방형 연질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 2년.
Storage 수분 및 열에 의해 품질에 영향을 받을 수 있으므로 직사광선을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. 어린이 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Copper · Manganese · Milk thistle · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc · Folate together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

This product combines 0.8mg of Copper, 3mg of Manganese, 130mg of Milk thistle, 90μg of Biotin, 3.6mg of Vitamin B1, 40μg of Vitamin B12, 4.2mg of Vitamin B2, 11mg of Vitamin E, 17.05μg of Selenium, 3.995mg of Zinc, 680μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 0.8mg Copper, 3mg Manganese, 130mg Milk thistle, 90μg Biotin, 3.6mg Vitamin B1, 40μg Vitamin B12, 4.2mg Vitamin B2, 11mg Vitamin E, 17.05μg Selenium, 3.995mg Zinc, 680μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)한풍네이처팜

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Copper
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the transport and utilisation of iron
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Milk thistle
    • May help with liver health
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
